title: Outbreak II
html:
Quest Giver: Junior Exec Ivan

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 15 Poison Mutant Twins and 3 Poison Mutant Twin Leaders in Upper Frump's Misfortune then Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Junior Exec Ivan

Repeatable: No

Zone: Frump's Misfortune (quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill 15 Poison Mutant Twins and 3 Poison Mutant Twin Leaders in Upper Frump's Misfortune then Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

Ah, am I glad to see you! The outbreak in Upper Frump's Misfortune has worsened and we believe the Poison Mutant Twins are the cause. The Frump has summoned to his aid a Lich Alchemist to get to the bottom of this outbreak and it said that Ick was not the original strain. The original strain is being called S-Ick-0 for 'Strain Ick Zero', the origin of the Ick and Ick-E strain. The Frump is getting ready to call all Dungeon Runners competing in Frump's Misfortune to The Boardroom to choose the winner of The Flunky, so you know what you have to do here. Trust me when I say that you don't want The Frump to fire you. I know there are tons of rumors as to what happenes when The Frump fires a Dungeon Runner, but I will tell you what really happens. He utters his famous, and powerful phrase, and the Dungeon Runner on the receiving end actually ignites into a ball of fire! Then, when that Dungeon Runner respawns, they are officially handed a pink slip.

Anyway, who cares why, how, or when the Poison Mutant Twins got S-Ick-0, you have to wipe it out. Or, at least wipe out enough to show a little effort. Run into the main areas of Upper Frump's Misfortune and cut snuff out the outbreak. Come and find me, Junior Exec Ivan, in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort when you have finished.

Turn-in:

Good deal, you made it back. Look, I'm not going to lie to you, you missed The Frump's call to The Boardroom. Ok, I was lying there. You didn't miss the call, you were specifically not invited. Dang! Sorry telling the truth doesn't really come easy to me. The Frump asked me to send you out to be killed by the S-Ick-0 strain so we could use your corpse for science, because hey, there is bound to be money in science. I'll give you a minute to digest that, but talk to me once you've processed that info.

Objectives:

  • Slain Poison Mutant Twins
  • Slain Poison Mutant Twin Leaders

Client level range: 35–45
